matched_rules.because: Signals show simultaneous failure of two cooling systems (redundant) and extraordinarily high outside temperatures, matching the 'when' conditions.

next_actions.action: Immediately assess whether the data center can maintain a safe operating temperature.
If safe temperature cannot be maintained, plan to power down servers to prevent an even longer outage or damage to machines.

escalate.reason: Simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems and rising temperatures (R-005 escalation trigger).

not_covered: No rule addresses the specific scenario of two cooling systems failing simultaneously without concurrent utility voltage swells or generator transfers.
No rule covers the initial alerting and investigation phase before cooling status is confirmed.
No rule provides guidance on assessing mitigations when cooling systems have failed but thermal buffer status is unknown.

per_finding.note: R-005 matches simultaneous redundant cooling failure plus extreme heat and directs assessing safe operating temperature.
Triage does not mention terminating PVMs or reducing thermal load via workload termination.
R-005 next action explicitly plans powering down servers if safe temperature cannot be maintained.
Triage contains no remediation practice for progressively decreasing thermal load.
Triage does not call for a global cooling system equipment audit.
Triage does not address measuring or reporting the duration of cooling failure impact.
